subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Should this repository adopt the no-role-bypass protected-`main` `openclaw/ci-gate` ruleset and merge the single-flight CI policy after a controlled live concurrency proof?
rationale: The branch changes protected default-branch enforcement and operational deletion controls; only maintainers with repository and Blacksmith access can safely confirm the external ruleset state and real rollout behavior.

options.title: Require protected-main proof
options.body: Capture redacted evidence that a running `main` CI completes while a newer push replaces only the pending run, then verify the cache warmer used the successful run’s head SHA and the ruleset requires `openclaw/ci-gate` without bypass.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the existing CI policy until maintainers can validate the branch-protection and Blacksmith operational assumptions in a controlled window.

recommendation.title: Require protected-main proof
recommendation.body: Capture redacted evidence that a running `main` CI completes while a newer push replaces only the pending run, then verify the cache warmer used the successful run’s head SHA and the ruleset requires `openclaw/ci-gate` without bypass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged and current work covers the affected CI cache lifecycle and concurrency implementation.
